question: Over the first full year of forward processing (2025-04-28 to 2026-04-27), does SWOT reach water surface elevation at Baton Rouge rise and fall by the same amount as the gauge, to within five percent?

lead.status: a lead, not a finding: found by exploring, tested on nothing, and it cannot be signed

set_aside.why: The hydrology bundle's signed SWOT lake dataset concept records that the Version D family changes from reprocessing (PGD0, through 2025-04-27) to forward processing (PID0) on 2025-04-28, and its signed river concept records the same two processing identifiers. Everything from that date on is one processing baseline, the request says none of it has been looked at, and it keeps growing, so it is what a later test would want. 2025-01-01 to 2025-04-27 is neither explored nor set aside.

working.description: Calendar 2024, the committed fixture swot_gauge_baton_rouge_2024.json in the hydrology capability (52 Version D passes, the gauge readings around each, and 47 Version C passes kept for the version step)
